label: Bible Study
prompt: Create in me a _____ heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
note: David's prayer after his sin with Bathsheba — he asks for a new heart, not a fresh coat of paint.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a _____, which is Christ the Lord.
verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
note: The angel's birth announcement to the shepherds — the KJV spells it 'Saviour,' British-style, with a 'u.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a _____, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verse: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
note: Moses lifted a serpent of brass on a pole — the very image Jesus later applied to himself in John 3.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your _____ ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verse: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
note: Fallow ground is land left hard and unplowed — Hosea says break the crust before expecting the rain.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, _____, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verse: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
note: God's own self-description to Moses on Sinai — 'longsuffering,' the KJV's one word for slow to anger.
